name: Bug Report
about: Create a report to help us improve unslop-windows
title: '[BUG] '
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Describe the Bug**
A clear and concise description of what happened.

**Windows Version & Build**
- Edition: (e.g. Windows 11 Pro or Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC)
- Version: (e.g. Win11 25H2/24H2/23H2, Win10 22H2/21H2/LTSC 2021/2019)
- Build Number: (Run `winver` or `[System.Environment]::OSVersion.Version`)

**Execution Mode Used**
- [ ] `unslop.bat` (Interactive Menu option: ____)
- [ ] `powershell -File .\unslop-win11.ps1` (Windows 11)
- [ ] `powershell -File .\unslop-win10.ps1` (Windows 10)
- [ ] `-DryRun`
- [ ] `-Undo`
- [ ] Other flags: (e.g. `-KeepTodos`, `-KeepXbox`, `-ClassicContextMenu`, `-SkipBuildCheck`)

**Logs**
Attach or paste the content from your log file (located at `.\logs\*.log` or `%LOCALAPPDATA%\unslop-windows\logs\`).

**Additional Context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the problem here.
